material_xray_constants — TOMOGRAPHY spectral_xray op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.material_xray_constants(material='CU', energy_kev: 'float' = 8.0, density_g_cm3=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import materials; materials.material_xray_constants(material='CU', energy_kev: 'float' = 8.0, density_g_cm3=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opstomography.get("material_xray_constants"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Return the X-ray constants at one energy (μ/ρ, μ_en/ρ, μ, half-value layer, mean free path) with their source.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

返り値: dict(name, energy_kev, mu_rho_cm2_g, mu_en_rho_cm2_g, density_g_cm3, mu_per_cm, hvl_mm = 10·ln 2/μ, mfp_mm = 10/μ, edges(±20 % の範囲にある吸収端の (元素, 端, keV)), kind, reference)。単色 X 線の半価層は ln 2/μ そのもの(多色の線質の半価層は dualxray.xray_beam_quality)。
